pre_install: $p = Get-Process -Name minply -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$(Split-Path $dir)\*" }; if ($p) { $p | Stop-Process -Force; $p | Wait-Process -Timeout 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
pre_uninstall: $p = Get-Process -Name minply -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$(Split-Path $dir)\*" }; if ($p) { $p | Stop-Process -Force; $p | Wait-Process -Timeout 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
